plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp boxing build phase with Week 1 used to establish training maxes for the main percentage-based lifts so the main work can start cleanly in Week 2. The block builds general strength first, keeps explosive work present, and adds one low-impact conditioning piece each week so you improve work capacity without taking away from boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish training maxes in Week 1, then build general strength and simple explosive qualities with controlled conditioning.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and power work while trimming unnecessary fatigue so quality stays high.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more emphasis toward faster, sharper outputs while keeping enough strength work to hold onto force.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Reset between reps. Jump fast and land quietly with control.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a box height that lets you land cleanly without tucking hard.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Pause briefly at the bottom and drive up fast.

exercises.name: 1b. Medicine Ball Rotational Scoop Throw
exercises.notes: Throw each rep hard from the hips. Use a non-bouncing or low-bounce ball if wall rebound is limited.

substitutionOptions.name: Medicine Ball Shot-Put Throw
substitutionOptions.notes: Keep the throw sharp and rotational with full hip turn.

substitutionOptions.name: Half-Kneeling Rotational Medicine Ball Throw
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if standing throws feel too loose.

exercises.name: 2. Front Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up progressively, then work up to one hard set of 3-5 clean reps. Stop if position breaks badly. This sets your baseline for future percentage work.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log the top set load and reps from your best clean set.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up in small jumps, then take one hard top set of 3-5 reps with solid depth and posture. Log the load and reps so future percentages are based on this result.

substitutionOptions.name: Back Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if front rack position is limited.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if available and front squat comfort is poor.

exercises.name: 3. Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Use a steady pull and a brief squeeze at the top. Keep the chest glued to the pad.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a neutral grip and keep the torso quiet.

substitutionOptions.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Brace well and avoid twisting.

exercises.name: 4. Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Ribs down and glutes tight. Only roll as far as you can keep the low back flat.

substitutionOptions.name: Stability Ball Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the wheel is too advanced.

substitutionOptions.name: Tall-Kneeling Cable Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Keep the trunk rigid the whole rep.

exercises.name: 5. Bicycling Aerobic Intervals
exercises.notes: Smooth aerobic work to build base fitness without extra impact on the legs.

endurancePrescription.intensity: Easy to moderate pace, nose-breathing or full-sentence talk test
endurancePrescription.target: Build aerobic base with low leg soreness
endurancePrescription.notes: Keep cadence smooth and finish feeling better than when you started.

exercises.name: 1a. Plyometric Push-Up

substitutionOptions.name: Hands-Elevated Plyometric Push-Up

substitutionOptions.name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass

substitutionOptions.name: Half-Kneeling Medicine Ball Chest Pass

substitutionOptions.name: Explosive Push-Up

exercises.name: 2. Bench Press
exercises.notes: Warm up progressively, then work up to one hard set of 3-5 clean reps. Keep your feet planted and bar path controlled. This sets your baseline for future percentage work.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log the top set load and reps from your best clean set.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up gradually, then take one hard top set of 3-5 reps with full control. Log the load and reps so future percentages are based on this result.

exercises.name: 3. Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Use bodyweight only if all reps stay clean. Stop with 1-2 reps left before form breaks.

substitutionOptions.name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use enough help to keep the reps clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Lat Pulldown
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a full stretch and pull to the upper chest.

exercises.name: 4. Cable Crunch
exercises.notes: Curl the ribs toward the pelvis and control the return. Do not turn it into a hip hinge.

substitutionOptions.name: Weighted Sit-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Keep the movement smooth and controlled.

substitutionOptions.name: Strict Hanging Knee Raise
substitutionOptions.notes: Avoid swinging.

exercises.name: 5. Neck Flexion and Extension
exercises.notes: Move slowly and stay well short of strain. Keep this light and controlled.

substitutionOptions.name: Manual Neck Isometrics
substitutionOptions.notes: Press gently into the hand for short controlled holds.

exercises.name: 3. One-Arm Dumbbell Row

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Row
